g.text: JP2 MS3: 1-2 bridged = MS3 low (DEFAULT): full 100 % / half 100 % / 1/16 / 1/32 with MS2 MS1. 2-3 = MS3 high: full 70 % / half 70 % / quarter / eighth.

g.text: JP1 ROSC: 1-2 bridged = ROSC to GND = APFD decay, tOFF 16 us (DEFAULT). Cut 1-2 and fit R12 = slow/mixed decay, tOFF = R / 825 us. Bridge 2-3 = ROSC high, tOFF 30 us.

g.desc: JP1 ROSC: 1-2 bridged = ROSC to GND = APFD decay, tOFF 16 us (DEFAULT). Cut 1-2 and fit R12 = slow/mixed decay, tOFF = R / 825 us. Bridge 2-3 = ROSC high, tOFF 30 us.

g.text: 04 / DECAY AND MICROSTEP STRAPS JP1 JP2 R12

g.desc: 04 / DECAY AND MICROSTEP STRAPS JP1 JP2 R12

g.text: NO HOT-PLUG of J2, J3 or J1. No chain socket, no 5 V selector, no logic regulator, no ESD parts on J1. Limit 24 V nominal, never exceed 26 V. nFAULT reports only the latched overcurrent fault (clear: RESET_N low or SLEEP low or VMOT cycle).

g.desc: NO HOT-PLUG of J2, J3 or J1. No chain socket, no 5 V selector, no logic regulator, no ESD parts on J1. Limit 24 V nominal, never exceed 26 V. nFAULT reports only the latched overcurrent fault (clear: RESET_N low or SLEEP low or VMOT cycle).

g.text: Y SOCKET J1 (CLAUDE.md section 3): 1 +3V3, 2 +5V (NOT CONNECTED, no backfeed path), 3 FAULT_N (out of U1, open drain), 4 STEP, 5 DIR, 6 ENABLE_N, 7 RESET_N, 8 MS1, 9 MS2, 10 GND.

g.desc: Y SOCKET J1 (CLAUDE.md section 3): 1 +3V3, 2 +5V (NOT CONNECTED, no backfeed path), 3 FAULT_N (out of U1, open drain), 4 STEP, 5 DIR, 6 ENABLE_N, 7 RESET_N, 8 MS1, 9 MS2, 10 GND.

g.text: DEFAULT-SAFE STATES: ENABLE_N 10k to +3V3 (outputs off), RESET_N 10k to +3V3, SLEEP_N 3.0 V from 10k/100k divider on +3V3 (chip sleeps if host +3V3 is absent), STEP and DIR 100k to GND, MS1/MS2 100k internal pull-down in U1.

g.desc: DEFAULT-SAFE STATES: ENABLE_N 10k to +3V3 (outputs off), RESET_N 10k to +3V3, SLEEP_N 3.0 V from 10k/100k divider on +3V3 (chip sleeps if host +3V3 is absent), STEP and DIR 100k to GND, MS1/MS2 100k internal pull-down in U1.

g.text: CURRENT LIMIT: ITripMAX = VREF / (8 x RS), RS = 0.100 ohm. VREF = 3.3 V x RV1 / (R2 + RV1): ceiling 1.18 V nominal = 1.47 A. SHIPPED 0.56 V = 0.70 A peak (full step 100 % torque default). Raise RV1 only after the host selects 1/16 or 1/32 microstepping.

g.desc: CURRENT LIMIT: ITripMAX = VREF / (8 x RS), RS = 0.100 ohm. VREF = 3.3 V x RV1 / (R2 + RV1): ceiling 1.18 V nominal = 1.47 A. SHIPPED 0.56 V = 0.70 A peak (full step 100 % torque default). Raise RV1 only after the host selects 1/16 or 1/32 microstepping.

g.text: VMOT PATH: J2 (+) -> F1 2 A fast fuse -> Q1 P-MOSFET (source to VMOT, drain to fused input, 100k gate pull-down R1, 12 V Zener D2) -> VMOT. D1 SMBJ24A, C1 100 uF, C2 C3 C4 and U1 VBB1/VBB2 sit AFTER Q1. J2 pad 1 = + is an ASSUMPTION.

g.desc: VMOT PATH: J2 (+) -> F1 2 A fast fuse -> Q1 P-MOSFET (source to VMOT, drain to fused input, 100k gate pull-down R1, 12 V Zener D2) -> VMOT. D1 SMBJ24A, C1 100 uF, C2 C3 C4 and U1 VBB1/VBB2 sit AFTER Q1. J2 pad 1 = + is an ASSUMPTION.

g.desc: 06 / INDICATORS D3 D4 AND BOTTOM TEST POINTS TP1-TP8

g.text: 02 / VMOT INPUT J2 (XT30), FUSE F1, REVERSE STAGE Q1, TVS D1, BULK AND CERAMICS

g.desc: 02 / VMOT INPUT J2 (XT30), FUSE F1, REVERSE STAGE Q1, TVS D1, BULK AND CERAMICS

g.text: CERN-OHL-S-2.0 | KiCad only | black solder mask, white silkscreen | 4 layers: F.Cu, In1.Cu GND, In2.Cu VMOT/GND, B.Cu GND.

g.desc: CERN-OHL-S-2.0 | KiCad only | black solder mask, white silkscreen | 4 layers: F.Cu, In1.Cu GND, In2.Cu VMOT/GND, B.Cu GND.

g.text: D1 and D2 use the stock Device:D_Zener symbol (pin 1 cathode, pin 2 anode); D_TVS is the bidirectional symbol and is not used for the unidirectional SMBJ24A.

g.desc: D1 and D2 use the stock Device:D_Zener symbol (pin 1 cathode, pin 2 anode); D_TVS is the bidirectional symbol and is not used for the unidirectional SMBJ24A.
